title: time-assistant week file
description: One reporting week exported from the source time system. Produced by an AI agent (or by hand), consumed by sync.py. `python3 sync.py validate --week FILE` enforces this shape offline.

from.description: First day of the period, yyyy-mm-dd.

time_events.description: EVERY time entry of the period, on every project. sync.py sends each project only to the targets configured for it.

id.description: Stable id in the source system: letters, digits, - and _ only. Becomes the [ta:t:<id>] tag on the row in each target.

activity_id.description: Source activity id, mapped per target by time_map in config.json.

project_id.description: Source project id; null if none. Decides which targets receive the entry. Never relabel.

status.description: Approval status copied exactly from the source, e.g. Open, Approved, Certified.

comment.description: The EXTERNAL (customer-visible) comment, sent to the targets. Never the internal comment.

expenses.description: Receipt-type expense entries of the period (use [] if none).

id.description: e.g. <expense nr>-<entry id>. Becomes the [ta:e:<id>] tag.

amount_ore.description: Total INCLUDING VAT in minor units (1/100 of the currency).

expense_type.description: Source expense type name, mapped per target by expense_map in config.json.

project_id.description: Project the expense is re-invoiced to; null if none.

receipt_file.description: Absolute path of the matching receipt file on the user's machine, user-confirmed.
